question: What was net revenue in USD for Q3 2026?
definition: Paid orders created 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30 (UTC), converted to USD at fx_rates.csv, minus every refund issued against those orders regardless of refund date. Cancelled orders and the export's Grand Total row are excluded.
alternatives: Refunds counted by refund date (only refunds issued in Q3): 8,710.00, because R03 (450.00) was issued Oct 2.
Quarter in America/New_York instead of UTC: O1016 (Oct 1 01:00 UTC = Sep 30 in New York) moves in.

steps.name: orders_clean
steps.note: drop the embedded Grand Total row; parse text amounts; timestamps are UTC
steps.sql:
SELECT order_id, customer_id, CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS created_at,
  upper(trim(currency)) AS currency, to_num(amount) AS amount, lower(trim(status)) AS status
FROM orders
WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id NOT ILIKE '%total%'

assert_zero.label: amounts that failed to parse
assert_zero.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders_clean WHERE amount IS NULL

steps.name: paid_q3
steps.sql:
SELECT * FROM orders_clean
WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND created_at <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'

steps.name: orders_usd
steps.note: convert to USD at the provided rates
steps.sql:
SELECT o.*, o.amount * CAST(f.usd_per_unit AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd
FROM paid_q3 o LEFT JOIN fx f ON f.currency = o.currency

assert_zero.label: orders with no FX rate
assert_zero.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders_usd WHERE amount_usd IS NULL

steps.name: refunds_by_order
steps.note: one row per order: all refunds against it, any refund date, in USD
steps.sql:
SELECT r.order_id, sum(to_num(r.amount) * CAST(f.usd_per_unit AS DOUBLE)) AS refund_usd
FROM refunds r JOIN fx f ON f.currency = upper(trim(r.currency))
GROUP BY r.order_id

steps.name: orders_net
steps.note: attach refunds (pre-aggregated per order, so no fan-out)
steps.sql:
SELECT o.*, coalesce(r.refund_usd, 0) AS refund_usd, o.amount_usd - coalesce(r.refund_usd, 0) AS net_usd
FROM orders_usd o LEFT JOIN refunds_by_order r ON r.order_id = o.order_id

steps.name: answer
steps.sql: SELECT round(sum(net_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd FROM orders_net

reconcile.label: sum of parsed order amounts (native currencies) equals the export's own Grand Total row
reconcile.expected: SELECT to_num(amount) FROM orders WHERE customer_id ILIKE '%grand total%'

reconcile.label: net = gross - refunds (independent sums)
reconcile.expected: SELECT (SELECT sum(amount_usd) FROM orders_usd) - (SELECT sum(refund_usd) FROM refunds_by_order WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders_usd))

caveats: FX is one fixed rate per currency from fx_rates.csv, not the rate on each order date.
